ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black field (approximately 92%) with localized high-intensity white punctate regions (approximately 8%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High density of small (1-5px) high-contrast white circular spots distributed uniformly across both lobes; brownish-tan 3D contiguous clusters observed at the extreme distal margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 35 degrees and a vertical depth reaching the midline of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with low-amplitude peaks (2-4px) and variable-width valleys extending from the median notch to the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating at the median notch transitioning to an upward convex sweep toward the dorsal-lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular, white pixel clusters ranging from 2-10px in diameter, covering over 60% of the visible ventral surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of raised, textured brownish-white nodules (barnacle colonization) localized on the leading edges of the distal tips of both lobes.
